subject: reading
title: The Hat in the Pond
about: Jim's hat lands in the pond and a duck brings it back. Practises short-vowel words with ck, qu, ll and blends (duck, quack, yells, gust, swims), plus the tricky words the, a, go, to, of, my, look, you, are and is. Decodable at CKLA Unit 1, so he can read it on his own.
tip: Cold read first, then read it to him, then let him read it again; let him do the duck's Quack.

passage.text:
Jim has a red hat.
Jim and Dad go to the pond.
A duck sits on a log.

A gust of wind hits the hat.
It lands in the pond.
"My hat!" yells Jim.

Jim looks and looks.
The hat is not there.
The duck has it on its back!
It swims to Jim.
"You are a pal, duck!"
"Quack!"

cards.note: Jim has a red hat; Dad goes with him to the pond.

cards.q: Where do Jim and Dad go?
cards.note: They go to the pond, where a duck sits on a log.
A gust of wind hits the hat and it lands in the pond.

cards.q: Who has the hat on its back?
cards.note: The duck has the hat on its back and swims it to Jim.

cards.q: What happens first in the story?
cards.note: First Jim and Dad go to the pond; the hat is lost after that, and the duck swims last.
The duck swims the hat back and Jim calls it a pal.

cards.q: How does Jim feel when the hat lands in the pond?
cards.note: Jim yells My hat!, so he is upset.

cards.q: Why does Jim say the duck is a pal?
cards.note: The duck brings the hat back on its back, so Jim calls it a pal.
A gust is a sudden strong puff of wind.

cards.q: Which word is in the story?
cards.note: Pond is in the story; pod and bond are look-alikes that are not.
